newsitem.title: MEXICO: Santander raises Mexico GDP forecast.
newsitem.headline: Santander raises Mexico GDP forecast.

text.p: Santander brokerage firm said on Friday it had raised its estimate of Mexican 1996 Gross Domestic Product growth to 4.5 percent from 4.2 percent.
Economists Enrique Ramirez and Hector Chavez said they also increased their third quarter GDP estimate to 7.4 percent growth from 5.9 percent.
They said the change was mostly due to higher estimates for industrial production.
"Given impressive growth in July and August industrial production, we have revised our third quarter estimate for the sector's output to 14.9 percent from 8.0 percent," they wrote in a report.
"Given that we still believe the economic recovery will slow slightly in the final quarter of the year, we are maintaining our 4.7 percent fourth quarter GDP growth forecast," they said.
